description: This source file implements HTML content translation within markdown documents. It parses markdown with embedded HTML, identifies HTML segments, applies translation through a provided translator interface, and safely replaces the original HTML segments with their translated versions, handling HTML tags correctly to avoid translation within certain tags like code or script.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Parses markdown content to identify HTML blocks and translates the embedded HTML segments using a provided translator, then applies the replacements to produce translated markdown.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the span (start and stop positions) of an HTML block within source byte array.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies sorted HTML replacements to the original body string, producing the translated content.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts the replacements slice by starting position to ensure proper application order.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Tokenizes HTML content, translates text nodes outside of certain tags, and reconstructs the HTML with translated text.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines if a text node should be translated based on its content and context.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag should be skipped for translation, such as 'code', 'pre', 'script', and 'style'.
